newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.002pts to 101.503.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.002pts to 101.503.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.002 points in Friday's trading to 101.503, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.498 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, remained unchanged at 97.703 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.370 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 0.136 points to 1,120.924.
